review_candidates.title: Group Controller

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working with complex accounting matters, multiple stakeholders, and an international business environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide accurate, timely and comprehensive financial reporting to stakeholders - including ad hoc reporting; Serve as the group-wide subject matter expert for IFRS compliance , performing technical reviews, drafting position papers, and providing global finance training. Proactively supporting local finance teams to ensure quality reporting; Lead the monthly, quarterly and annual close reporting process for the area scope, working closely with the appropriate stakeholders (local finance teams, FP&A, tax, valuation); Execute the performance of review and analysis on group entities and reports. Including follow-up on recommendations and reporting queries; Execute the preparation of the consolidated annual report together with a team; Establish, implement and monitor the group's finance policies and procedures/ practices incorporating accounting policies, including compliance with post-acquisition accounting adjustments; Support the group finance processing operation, driving efficiency through process improvement and standardization. This includes the execution of internal controls applicable to the group control team and serving as a point of contact for control compliance related to the group reporting process; Interface with external auditors for annual audits, including preparation of required disclosure notes and documentation as well as alignment on timeline; Execute the statutory audit preparation of corporate entities to ensure timely filing and quality assurance. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Master's degree in finance, accounting, business administration or related field 8+ years of working experience in accounting, financial reporting, group finance, consolidation, or audit. Strong and proven IFRS knowledge – essential . Organizational sensitivity, international experience is an asset; Clear communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts in an understandable manner and present complex problems and matching solutions Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor. You can also send your updated CV to hr@foursymmetrons.com with the subject line “Application – Group Controller” . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

review_candidates.title: General Manager | Boutique Retreat & Glamping
review_candidates.description: GENERAL MANAGER | BOUTIQUE RETREAT & GLAMPING We are building a new design-driven boutique retreat and glamping destination in the mountains near Almaty. This is not a traditional hotel and not a standard glamping project. Our vision is to create a distinctive hospitality concept combining nature, privacy, contemporary design, wellness, sauna, curated food experiences, retreats, outdoor activities and exceptional personalized service. The project is being built from the ground up, and we are looking for a General Manager who wants to take ownership of the entire hospitality business and grow with it long term. YOUR MISSION Build and operate the retreat as a profitable, highly regarded hospitality business with a strong brand, exceptional guest experience and minimal day-to-day involvement from the Founder. You will have significant autonomy and responsibility for the entire operation. YOU WILL OWN • overall P&L and operating performance; • revenue, occupancy, ADR and profitability; • guest experience and service standards; • recruitment, training and leadership of the hospitality team; • accommodation operations and housekeeping standards; • food & beverage and curated dining experiences; • sauna, wellness, retreats and additional guest experiences; • Booking, Airbnb, direct bookings and other distribution channels; • sales, partnerships and commercial initiatives; • budgeting, purchasing and cost control; • SOPs, reporting, KPIs and operational systems; • reputation, reviews and guest retention; • development of new experiences and revenue streams; • preparation of the concept for future expansion and additional locations. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for an entrepreneurial hospitality leader, not simply an administrator. Ideally, you have: • 5+ years of hospitality management experience; • experience managing a boutique hotel, resort, premium glamping, retreat or similar hospitality business; • responsibility for revenue, budgets and operating results; • strong understanding of premium guest experience; • experience building and managing teams; • commercial thinking and understanding of hospitality economics; • high standards of aesthetics, service and attention to detail; • the ability to build systems from scratch rather than simply inherit them; • strong ownership mentality and the ability to operate independently; • Russian and English; Kazakh is a strong advantage. Experience launching a new hospitality property from zero is a major advantage. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Within the first 12 months, we want to build a retreat with: • strong occupancy and healthy unit economics; • exceptional guest reviews; • a recognizable hospitality brand; • consistent service standards; • a strong and reliable team; • multiple revenue streams beyond accommodation; • clear management reporting and financial discipline; • operations that do not require constant Founder involvement. THE OPPORTUNITY We are not looking for someone who simply wants another management position. We are looking for someone who wants to build something. The right person will have substantial autonomy, direct access to the Founder and the opportunity to grow together with the business as we expand the concept. We believe exceptional people should participate meaningfully in the value they help create. If you think like an owner, care deeply about hospitality and want to build one of the most distinctive retreat concepts in Kazakhstan from the beginning, we would like to meet you.

Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan de individuele melding. Wanneer je merkt dat hetzelfde probleem steeds terugkomt, ga je op zoek naar de echte oorzaak. Ligt het aan de inrichting, een proces, de kwaliteit van de data of wordt een werkwijze niet goed gevolgd? Waar nodig voer je een tijdelijke handmatige correctie uit zodat de operatie door kan. Maar je bent pas écht tevreden wanneer die correctie uiteindelijk niet meer nodig is. Daarmee ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen de dagelijkse operatie, leveranciers, Development, Product Owners en Business Consultants. Dit ga je doen Je ondersteunt gebruikers van Business Central en LS Retail bij functionele vragen, incidenten en wijzigingsverzoeken. Je beheert de backlog, bewaakt prioriteiten en zorgt voor een goede afhandeling van meldingen. Je analyseert incidenten en bepaalt of de oorzaak ligt in data, processen, configuratie of systeemgedrag. Je voert waar nodig tijdelijke correcties uit zodat bedrijfsprocessen kunnen blijven doorgaan. Je beheert de functionele inrichting van Business Central en LS Retail en voert configuratiewijzigingen zorgvuldig door. Je ondersteunt releases, testen en implementaties. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data en signaleert afwijkingen voordat deze impact hebben op de operatie. Je documenteert oplossingen, inrichting en werkwijzen zodat kennis behouden blijft. Je signaleert terugkerende problemen en vertaalt deze naar structurele verbeteringen of wijzigingsvoorstellen. Je werkt dagelijks samen met gebruikers, key users, leveranciers en collega's binnen Digital Enablement. Wat jij meebrengt Je krijgt energie van structuur en kwaliteit. Je vindt het leuk om gebruikers te helpen, houdt overzicht in een dynamische omgeving en weet prioriteiten te stellen wanneer meerdere zaken tegelijk spelen. Je bent analytisch genoeg om de oorzaak van een probleem te achterhalen, maar ook praktisch genoeg om eerst de operatie weer op gang te helpen wanneer dat nodig is. Je begrijpt dat goed applicatiebeheer niet alleen draait om het oplossen van meldingen, maar vooral om het voorkomen dat dezelfde meldingen blijven terugkomen. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

Process Improvement & Systems Review and improve finance processes, policies, and internal controls to support business growth. Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories! Key Responsibilities The Field Officer is responsible for implementing Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), Anticipatory Action (AA) and resilience-building activities at the field level to achieve project objectives and strengthen community preparedness for disasters and emergencies. The position ensures quality project implementation, stakeholder engagement, monitoring and reporting, compliance with organizational and donor requirements, and the integration of GEDSI, safeguarding, and accountability principles while fostering sustainable partnerships with communities, schools, local authorities, and other key stakeholders. KEY RESPONSIBILITES PROJECT PLANNING AND MANAGEMENT (60%) Develop province-level annual, quarterly, and monthly operational plans, integrating logical framework targets, implementation timelines, risk mitigation measures, and approved budget allocations. Conduct Community Participatory Disaster Risk Assessments (CPDRA) at target locations and support communities in developing or updating disaster preparedness plans. Facilitate the capacity of communities, schools, government counterparts, and local partners through training and technical support on: “Be Ready” Training Module Comprehensive School Safety Framework Junior Rescuer Club Other Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), resilience, and preparedness initiatives as assigned. Coordinate the implementation of Anticipatory Action (AA) interventions upon activation at the fields, ensuring timely, effective, and accountable delivery in accordance with humanitarian principles, national guidelines, international standards, and organizational protocols. Lead procurement, logistics coordination, distribution, and utilization of project assets, equipment, supplies, and training materials in compliance with organizational and donor requirements. Establish Community Learning and Training Centers, including stakeholder engagement and resource management. Ensure full compliance with World Vision policies, safeguarding standards, donor requirements, financial regulations, and project management procedures. PROJECT MONITORING AND REPORTING (20%) Monitor and analyze community conditions, hazard events, disaster risks, and emergency situations, and provide timely updates, alerts, and operational information to the project team and relevant stakeholders. Collect, verify, and maintain accurate and timely project performance data across all implementation locations, ensuring alignment with project indicators, targets, and monitoring frameworks. Conduct project monitoring, including Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM), rapid needs assessments, GEDSI analyses, market assessments, outcome monitoring, beneficiary satisfaction surveys, and end-line evaluations, ensuring quality data collection and analysis. Establish community-based accountability mechanisms, including feedback, complaints, and response systems in fields, to promote transparency, participation, responsiveness, and adaptive project management. Manage regular field monitoring visits to assess implementation progress, service quality, adherence to technical standards, beneficiary and partnership engagement, and achievement of planned outputs and outcomes. Record lessons learned, best practices, success stories, case studies, and project achievements in fields to support organizational learning, knowledge management, and program quality improvement. PARTNERSHIP, ADVOCACY AND SUSTAINABILITY (15%) Strengthen strategic collaboration mechanisms among local government authorities, communities, schools, humanitarian actors, and service providers. Facilitate and implement community-led Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) awareness, advocacy actions, and behavior change campaigns. The role offers an extraordinarily steep learning curve , unparalleled exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to work directly alongside one of the region’s most prominent business leaders. Handle highly sensitive, confidential and commercially important information with absolute discretion. Liaise across different functions and businesses to ensure seamless execution of the Chairman’s requirements. Anticipate problems before they arise and proactively identify solutions. Undertake ad hoc projects and assignments of a sensitive or strategic nature as required. The Nature of the Role This is a high-intensity, demanding and highly coveted position that requires an exceptional level of commitment. Availability during evenings and, at times, weekends and public holidays , depending on the Chairman’s schedule and business requirements. Managing urgent requests with very short turnaround times. The ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion. Excellent interpersonal skills and the confidence to interact with senior stakeholders. The flexibility to work according to the demands of the Chairman’s schedule. The Learning Curve The learning curve in this position will be extremely steep . The successful candidate will be expected to absorb information quickly, understand the Chairman’s preferences and working style, learn the intricacies of a complex business environment and progressively anticipate requirements with increasing independence. This role will suit someone who is highly ambitious, intellectually curious and eager to learn , and who views exposure to a Chairman and senior leadership as an opportunity to develop at an accelerated pace. The expectation is not simply to become familiar with the role, but to continually raise the standard of support provided . Personal Attributes The successful candidate is likely to be: Discreet | Highly Intelligent | Exceptionally Organised | Resilient | Proactive | Adaptable | Detail-Oriented | Commercially Aware | Resourceful | Composed | Highly Professional Above all, the candidate must possess absolute integrity and discretion . The ability to handle confidential information and sensitive situations without compromise is non-negotiable. Why This Opportunity This is a rare and highly sought-after opportunity to work at the very heart of a highly successful and internationally recognised business organisation. The role provides exposure that is difficult to replicate in a conventional Executive Assistant position, together with the opportunity to work closely with one of the region’s most prominent business leaders. For the right individual, this can be a transformational career opportunity , offering accelerated professional development, extraordinary exposure and a steep learning curve. However, the role comes with equally high expectations. It demands commitment, stamina, flexibility, discretion and an exceptional standard of performance . This is a role for someone who wants to operate at the highest level — and is prepared to match that environment with an equally high level of commitment. review_candidates.title: Document Controller - Kvandal
review_candidates.description: Document Controller Department: Project Controls / PMO About CTS Group CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specialising in data centre development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data centre solutions. With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture where innovation and technical precision drive every project. Beyond construction, CTS develops digital systems and standardised modular data centre units to meet the evolving needs of hyperscale’s, colocation providers, and enterprise clients. Our proven track record and strong partnerships have established CTS as a trusted industry leader, delivering large-scale, complex data centre facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence. About The Role CTS Group is seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our Norway team and play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of major data centre projects across the UK and wider EMEA region. Reporting into the Project Controls function, the Document Controller will be responsible for the overall governance, management, and continuous improvement of document control processes across multiple projects. The successful candidate will serve as the subject matter expert for document management systems, ensuring all project information is accurate, compliant, accessible, and auditable throughout the project lifecycle. This is a leadership role requiring the ability to manage document control activities, mentor junior team members, and work closely with project managers, engineering teams, contractors, consultants, and clients. Key Responsibilities Document Control Leadership Lead and manage document control activities across multiple data centre construction projects. Develop, implement, and maintain document control procedures, standards, and best practices. Act as the primary point of contact for all document management and information control matters. Support and mentor Document Controllers and project administration teams, ensuring consistency across projects. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance document control efficiency and data quality. Project Documentation Management Establish and maintain robust document control systems, workflows, and version control processes. Manage the receipt, review, distribution, tracking, and archiving of project documentation, including: Technical drawings BIM deliverables Specifications RFIs and submittals Contracts and commercial documentation Permits and compliance records Testing and commissioning documentation Handover and close-out records Ensure documents are correctly classified, stored, and maintained within project information management systems. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate the flow of project documentation between clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal project teams. Monitor document review cycles and approval workflows, ensuring project deadlines are achieved. Provide training and guidance to project stakeholders on document control procedures and systems. Support internal and external audits relating to project documentation and information governance. Reporting & Compliance Produce and distribute regular reports on document status, submissions, approvals, overdue items, and project KPIs. Maintain auditable records that comply with client requirements, contractual obligations, and CTS standards. Ensure compliance with ISO standards, information management protocols, and project governance requirements. Support project teams during commissioning, handover, and close-out phases to ensure complete and accurate documentation packages. Essential Skills, Experience & Qualifications Minimum 2-5 years' experience in document control within construction, engineering, infrastructure, or data centre projects. Demonstrable experience leading document control activities on large-scale construction projects. Strong knowledge of project lifecycle documentation and information management principles. Experience working with document management systems such as Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Procore, SharePoint, Asite, or equivalent platforms. Excellent understanding of document numbering, revision control, transmittals, workflows, and audit requirements. Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities within fast-paced project environments. Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Desirable Experience working on data centre, mission-critical, or large-scale MEP projects. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and ISO 19650 information management standards. Experience supporting BIM and digital delivery processes. Understanding of commissioning and project handover requirements. Degree or equivalent qualification in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Information Management, or a related discipline. Values & Conduct All CTS colleagues uphold the CTS Group Code of Conduct. In this role, the post-holder will demonstrate: Integrity in Business Practices – maintaining the highest ethical standards in all interactions and decisions. Honest and Transparent Communication – ensuring accurate reporting and professional conduct at all times. Confidentiality & Data Protection – safeguarding company, client, and employee information. Health, Safety & Environmental Commitment – actively supporting CTS's zero-harm culture and ESG objectives. Respect & Inclusion – fostering a diverse, collaborative, and respectful workplace. Accountability & Leadership – leading by example and promoting best practice across project teams. What We Offer Opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing data centre design and build organisations in EMEA. Exposure to landmark data centre developments across the UK and Europe. Career progression within a rapidly expanding international business. Collaborative, multicultural, and innovative working environment. Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to shape and enhance document control standards across a portfolio of high-profile projects. At CTS Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the successful delivery of complex data centre projects through exceptional information management, governance, and team leadership. Your expertise will directly contribute to project efficiency, compliance, and operational excellence across our growing portfolio.

review_candidates.title: Director of Customer Success
review_candidates.description: The role We’re looking for a senior, hands-on leader to own the success and operational performance of a diverse portfolio of clients. The role brings together customer success, commercial ownership and operations . You’ll work close enough to clients to understand what drives their success, connect patterns across the portfolio, and turn those insights into changes in how we onboard, deliver, organise teams and use technology. Our service model is evolving across people-led, technology-enabled and AI-supported services. You’ll need to operate effectively in that ambiguity: run what exists today, challenge what isn’t working, and build better ways of operating as we learn. You’ll be equally comfortable getting deep into an individual client problem and stepping back to ask what it tells us about the broader system. What you’ll own Client and portfolio performance. Understand what clients need, identify patterns and intervene where customer outcomes, retention or economics need to change. Operational delivery and improvement. Keep day-to-day delivery moving while improving the processes, systems and ways of working behind it. Commercial performance. Understand customer value, cost to serve, retention and margin, and use that perspective to make better client and operational decisions. Scalability and technology. Challenge complexity, handoffs and manual work. Use better process, systems, automation and AI to solve problems and support scale. Client onboarding and growth readiness. Work across Growth, Delivery and HR to make onboarding repeatable and ensure workforce, hiring and capacity plans anticipate demand. Organisation and capability. Design the organisation around what the portfolio needs, select and develop strong people, build leverage through your team, and question structures that no longer fit. Cross-functional execution. Work across Growth, HR, Product, Technology and senior leadership to resolve dependencies and move decisions into action. What we're looking for We’re open-minded about where you’ve built your experience. You might come from Customer Success, Customer Operations, managed services, technology-enabled services, scale-up operations, Business Operations or BPO/service delivery. The common thread we're looking for is end-to-end ownership . You've had to understand a customer or business problem, understand what's really causing it, decide what to do, implement the change and live with the consequences. We’re looking for: Critical thinking and judgement. You absorb complex and sometimes contradictory information, find the signal and reach a view without waiting for perfect information. Ownership and pace. You take problems through to resolution, keep things moving and close loops. Operational depth. You understand how work actually gets done and can move comfortably between the detail and the bigger system. Commercial judgement. You understand customer value, retention, cost and margin and can make sensible trade-offs between them. Systems thinking. You connect individual problems to broader patterns and redesign the underlying process or system where needed. Technology fluency. You are comfortable using modern systems, automation and AI and can see practical opportunities to apply them to operations. Influence. You can absorb different perspectives, challenge constructively, make a persuasive case and create alignment across functions. People judgement and organisation design. You can assess capability, select and develop people, delegate meaningful ownership and design teams around the work that needs to be done. Leadership experience. You’ve managed senior individual contributors or a team of leaders. Experience managing managers is highly advantageous. BPO or outsourced customer service experience is useful, but not required. Product experience is also useful, particularly if you've worked at the intersection of customer problems and service design. We care more about the quality and complexity of the problems you’ve owned than the size of the organisation you’ve managed. This role may suit you if... You like getting to the bottom of messy problems and making sense of competing signals. You can spend one hour working through the economics and customer experience of an individual account, then use what you learned to question something about the broader operating model. You naturally look for patterns. When the same problem appears twice, you want to understand what in the system is allowing it to happen. You make decisions, test ideas and adjust as you learn. Ambiguity doesn't become a reason to leave decisions sitting unresolved. You enjoy building through people while remaining a strong individual contributor yourself. Why Influx Influx provides customer support for brands and technology companies around the world, 24/7. We’re a fully remote, global company , with more than 1,000 people working across 15+ countries. This role is based in Indonesia, working with colleagues and clients across multiple countries, cultures and time zones. You'll have: Genuine global exposure , working across an international client portfolio and distributed teams. Fully remote work from Indonesia , in a company that has operated remotely for more than a decade. Broad scope and meaningful ownership , spanning clients, operations, commercial performance, people and technology. Direct access to senior leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions across Delivery, Growth, HR, Product and Technology. Room to shape how we operate , as our service models continue to evolve across people, technology and AI. If you enjoy owning complex customer and operational problems and turning what you learn into practical change, we’d like to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Dealing Operations
review_candidates.description: Location: South Jakarta Employment Type: Permanent with 3 months probation Company Description HSB Investasi is a futures brokerage firm that provides Foreign Exchange (Forex), Commodity, and Stock Index trading services through mobile applications. As a local broker operating under the supervision of the Indonesian Commodity Futures Trading Regulatory Agency (BAPPEBTI) and the Ministry of Trade of the Republic of Indonesia, HSB ensures security and credibility. With a one-stop solution, HSB offers convenience, speed, and 24/7 customer service to assist clients. HSB Investasi aims to help clients maximize their investment potential and achieve their financial goals. About the Role This is an operations-focused dealing role. You will run the day-to-day trading operations of the dealing desk: monitoring client trading activity, preparing reports, reconciling trades and balances, and coordinating with internal teams, clients, Compliance and regulators. The role does not involve market analysis, trading signals or proprietary trading decisions. It suits someone who is reliable, organized and takes pride in getting the numbers right and on time. Working Hours This position may occasionally require working night shifts as part of the job responsibilities. Regular Hour: 09:00 - 18:00 / 9 AM - 6 PM Night Shift: 13:00 - 22:00 / 1 PM - 10 PM Key Accountabilities • Carry out routine daily dealing-desk operations, including monitoring client trading activity, open positions and account status on the MT4/MT5 platform according to established procedures. • Prepare accurate and timely daily, weekly and monthly reports on trading activity, client positions and desk operations for management and relevant departments. • Perform daily reconciliation of trades, positions, deposits/withdrawals and balances between the trading platform, liquidity providers, clearing house and internal records; investigate and resolve breaks. • Ensure all transactions are properly recorded and that regulatory reports are submitted to the relevant authorities (e.g. BAPPEBTI and the clearing house) accurately and before deadlines. • Identify abnormalities such as pricing errors, unusual trading patterns, platform or connectivity issues and data mismatches, and escalate them promptly to the appropriate team. • Coordinate with Finance, Customer Service, IT, Compliance and other departments to resolve trade-related and operational issues. • Respond to client enquiries and trade-related issues in a clear, professional manner, together with the Customer Service team. • Support Compliance and management in preparing documentation, data and explanations for audits, regulatory enquiries and inspections when required. • Assist with platform administration tasks such as setting up new products, symbol specifications and trading configurations as instructed, in line with regulatory requirements. • Maintain and help improve standard operating procedures, checklists and logs for dealing-desk operations. What We’re Looking For • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Statistics or a related field. • 1–3 years of experience in brokerage, trading operations, financial operations, back office or reconciliation. • Good Microsoft Excel and data-handling skills (e.g. formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, working with large data sets). • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, with the discipline to meet daily and regulatory deadlines. • Able to spot abnormalities or inconsistencies in data and escalate issues appropriately. • Good communication and coordination skills; comfortable working with different departments, clients, Compliance and regulators. • Good written and spoken English. • Reliable, organized, process-driven and operations-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership for assigned tasks. • Willing to work shifts, including occasional night shifts. Nice to Have • Basic understanding of forex/CFD products and how a brokerage dealing desk operates. • Hands-on experience with MetaTrader 4/5 (MT4/MT5), especially the Manager or Administrator terminal. • Familiarity with Indonesian futures industry regulations and reporting (BAPPEBTI, clearing house). • Experience preparing regulatory or management reports in a financial institution. Note: This role is not a trading or market-analysis position. Candidates whose background is mainly in technical analysis, trading signals or personal trading may not be a good fit. All personal data submitted will be used solely for recruitment purposes and stored securely in our database. Your information will not be shared with third parties without your consent.
